name: Matt Pocock Engineering Workflows
description: Run real-engineering loops with Matt Pocock's composable skill modules: TDD, code review, bug diagnosis, specs and tickets, triage, PRs, prototyping, research, grilling interviews, handoffs and more — 39 modules in one package.
author: Matt Pocock

zh.name: Pocock 工程流
zh.description: 用 Matt Pocock 的可组合工程技能模块跑真实的工程流程：TDD、代码评审、缺陷诊断、规格与工单、问题分诊、PR 撰写、原型验证、调研、拷问式评审、会话交接等——一个包内含 39 个功能模块。
